QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: National Pension System (NPS)_86

question.text: Which of the following is the settlor of NPS Trust?

explanation.text: The Logic: PFRDA is the settlor of NPS Trust. The Trust is set up under the Indian Trusts Act and governed by PFRDA (NPS Trust) Regulations 2015. The Trap: The settlor creates the trust. PFRDA created NPS Trust to hold subscriber assets separately from the regulatory body. Cross-Exam Context: Settlor = PFRDA. Trust = holds assets. The custodian is the SEBI-registered custodian appointed by PFRDA from time to time, and is named on PFRDA's current website (e.g., the entity listed on the page last verified 2026-05-15). Avoid memorising a fixed custodian name in exam preparation, since it can change.
